name: Blood Runs Cold fills Blood Pact's healing-received clause (#893)
contract: Blood Runs Cold 560257's tooltip is "Your Blood Pact now also increases your healing received by $s1%", with $s1 = 20 (BasePoints 19 + DieSides 1). Its single effect is aura 107 with EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0, 65536) = word 2 bit 16 = Blood Pact 801955/801964, and MiscValue 3, which is SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 - the operation Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers maps to effect index 0. Blood Pact's effect 0 is aura 185 MOD_ATTACKER_RANGED_HIT_CHANCE with BasePoints -51 + DieSides 1 = -50, the value its own tooltip renders as $s3, so the talent was quietly weakening the ranged-miss clause to -30 while the healing clause stayed empty. The placeholder the tooltip fills is effect index 1: aura 118 SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_PCT with MiscValue 127 (all schools) and amount 0, and Blood Pact's own Description carries the matching conditional "$?s560257[, and increasing your healing received by $560257s1%][]". SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 (12) is the operation that reaches index 1. Two discriminating assertions: with the talent learned, Blood Pact's effect 1 must read 20 (0 today) and its effect 0 must still read -50 (-30 today).
